title: Cabanas and Sunsets | Designer Condo | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Cabanas and Sunsets is a luxury 30A condo near Rosemary Beach with rooftop Gulf views, a heated resort pool, fitness center, and easy beach access.
description_expanded: Cabanas and Sunsets Features - 2 Min bike ride to Winston Lane Beach Access - bike racks available - 5 Min bike ride to the Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access. This is the largest county beach access, and offers beach service, parking, restrooms, access ramps, and lifeguards (during peak seasons). - Access to 3 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly - Access to resort style pool (heated seasonally) with cabana seating and an outdoor fireplace. (No lifeguards on duty at the pool.) - Gulf views from the rooftop lounge (Rooftop Sanctuary) - Community hot tub - Community Fitness Center with Peloton Bike and Mirror Virtual Trainer - Rooftop Sanctuary - Gulf views, lounge furniture, TVs, and fire pit. Bring your own food and beverages for sunset viewing. - La Cava Lounge - poolside covered patio with lounge furniture and TVs - Tesla Charging Station - Community Outdoor grills available - Interiors furnished in Restoration Hardware - Private workspace available in the king suite, with desk and chair - WIFI and Smart TV streaming available - Parking for 2 vehicles in parking lot on a first come, first serve basis (parking passes left in the condo). RVs, trailers, or other oversized vehicles are not permitted to park on site. - Elevator and stair access to 2nd floor unit. Condo is all one level - ADA Parking directly in front of building with no step entry to elevator bay. - No steps to enter the condo - Private balconies overlooking resort pool - Full kitchen with stainless steel Whirlpool appliances - Breakfast Bar seating for 4 and outdoor dining on the balcony for 4 - Laundry closet with washer and dryer in the condo - Community does not allow guests to have pets on site - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, catered beach bonfires, and baby equipment rentals Loaded with extras, our condo at The Pointe next to Rosemary Beach is perfect for your next getaway. Access to luxury amenities including a heated resort pool and outdoor fireplace, deluxe on-site gym, and rooftop lounge with Gulf views makes this condo heads above all others. Located on 30A and adjacent to Rosemary Beach, you may never need to get in your car once you arrive. Shades Bar and Grill is across the street, with a great beer list and a Happy Hour Monday-Friday. 30Avenues, with upscale shopping, casual and upscale dining, plus live entertainment, is across the street and is easily accessed via the new Pedestrian Tunnel at Hwy 30A and Hwy 98. Easily bike to Rosemary Town Center in 3-minutes, featuring even more upscale shopping and dining. Area Construction - Our area is getting more popular each year! There is a possibility of nearby construction, community changes and projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects.
rooms_guidance: King Suite | TV, private balcony, blackout curtains, ensuite bath with dual vanity sink, soaking tub, walk-in shower, private water closet, reach-in closet
Queen Suite | TV, closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with a walk-in shower
Bunk Area | Built-in Twin Bunk with guard rail and attached ladder for top bunk, curtain for privacy
Sleeper Sofa | Queen Sleeper Sofa in living room

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
